Caller: Hi. We're a mid-size e-commerce retailer and we need a voice agent to handle order tracking and returns before the holiday rush.
Agent: Thanks for calling. Could I get your name and company?
Caller: I'm Grace Liu from Bramblewood Outfitters. I'm the director of customer operations.
Agent: Thanks, Grace. What call volume do you expect over the holidays?
Caller: Around twenty-five thousand calls across November and December.
Agent: Got it. Do you have a budget for this?
Caller: Yes. We have $47,250 left in this year's budget, as a one-time spend for the project.
Agent: And when do you need it live?
Caller: By November first, so within about six weeks.
Agent: Understood. Are you the one who'd sign off?
Caller: Yes, I have signing authority for this.
Agent: Great. Would you like someone from our team to follow up to scope the rollout?
Caller: Please do. My email is grace.liu@example.com and my direct line is 206-555-0173.
Agent: Perfect, I'll pass both along. Thanks, Grace.

expected.need_summary: E-commerce retailer needs a voice agent for order tracking and returns before the holiday rush, expecting about 25,000 calls in November and December.
expected.intent_evidence: Caller has $47,250 as a one-time spend, needs it live by November 1 (about six weeks), and has signing authority.
expected.call_summary: Grace Liu, director of customer operations at Bramblewood Outfitters, needs a voice agent for order tracking and returns live by November 1 (about six weeks) ahead of ~25k holiday calls. One-time budget of $47,250. She has signing authority. Follow up to scope rollout: grace.liu@example.com, 206-555-0173.

transcript:
Agent: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant for Acme Voice. This call is recorded so our team can follow up. What brings you in today?
Caller: Hello, I'm calling from Bengaluru. We're a fintech startup and our customer support line needs Hindi and English voice automation.
Agent: Thanks for calling. Could I get your name and company?
Caller: Arjun Nair, head of support at Paisaflow Technologies.
Agent: Thanks, Arjun. What calls would the agent handle?
Caller: KYC status questions, failed payment queries, and card blocks. Around three thousand calls a day.
Agent: Got it. Do you have a budget in mind?
Caller: We've set aside around 8 lakh rupees a year for this.
Agent: Thanks. When would you want to go live?
Caller: Within the next two to three months, ideally before our Diwali campaign.
Agent: And are you the one making the decision?
Caller: Yes, I own the support budget and I'll make the final call.
Agent: Great. Would you like someone from our team to follow up?
Caller: Yes, please email arjun.nair@example.org.
Agent: Will do. Thank you, Arjun.

expected.need_summary: Fintech startup needs Hindi and English voice automation for KYC status, failed payment queries, and card blocks, around 3,000 calls a day.
expected.intent_evidence: Caller set aside about 8 lakh rupees a year, wants to go live in 2-3 months before Diwali, and makes the final call.
expected.call_summary: Arjun Nair, head of support at Paisaflow Technologies (Bengaluru fintech), needs Hindi/English voice automation for KYC status, failed payments, and card blocks (~3,000 calls/day). Budget about 8 lakh INR/year (~$9,639/year). Go live within 2-3 months, before the Diwali campaign. He is the decision maker. Email arjun.nair@example.org.

notes: Adversarial non-USD budget: caller said 'around 8 lakh rupees a year' = 800,000 INR/year. Converted at 1 USD = 83 INR: 800000 / 83 = 9638.55, rounded to 9639 USD; period annual.

Agent: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant for Acme Voice. This call is recorded so our team can follow up. What brings you in today?
Caller: Hi, I'm with Cedarline Travel. Our reservations line has a forty-minute hold time and we're losing bookings. We need help now.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Could I get your name and role?
Caller: Sofia Marchetti, I'm the reservations manager.
Agent: Thanks, Sofia. What would you want an AI agent to take over first?
Caller: Booking changes and seat or baggage questions. That's most of the queue.
Agent: Got it. Do you have a budget for this?
Caller: We're prepared to spend about $18,500 a month.
Agent: Thanks. When would you need this in place?
Caller: Immediately. Every week of these hold times costs us bookings.
Agent: Understood. Would you be making the final decision?
Caller: No, our CFO signs off on anything like this, but she's already asked me to find a vendor.
Agent: That's helpful. Would you like someone from our team to follow up with you?
Caller: Yes. My email is s-o-f-i-a dot m-a-r-c-h-e-t-t-i at example dot com, so sofia.marchetti@example.com.
Agent: Thank you, Sofia. Someone will be in touch shortly.

expected.need_summary: Travel agency reservations line has 40-minute holds and lost bookings; wants an AI agent for booking changes and seat or baggage questions.
expected.intent_evidence: Caller is prepared to spend about $18,500/month and needs it immediately; the CFO signs off but asked her to find a vendor.
expected.call_summary: Sofia Marchetti, reservations manager at Cedarline Travel, needs relief from 40-minute hold times that are costing bookings; wants AI for booking changes and seat/baggage questions. Budget about $18,500/month. Needed immediately. CFO signs off but has asked her to find a vendor. Follow up at sofia.marchetti@example.com.
